<style>
:root{
  --bg:#080808;--surface:#111;--text:#f0f0f0;--body:#c0c0c0;
  --dim:#888;--faint:#2a2a2a;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--line-hi:rgba(255,255,255,.32);
  --nav-w:68px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
  --ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
  --ease-in-out:cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1);
  --t-fast:.18s;--t-mid:.28s;--t-slow:.52s;
  --ff:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;
  --fh:"Bebas Neue",sans-serif;
  --fn:"Syne",sans-serif;
  --fb:"DM Sans",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --hero-label:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  --hero-label-dim:rgba(255,255,255,.42);
  --hero-accent:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
  --hero-scroll:rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  --hero-tag:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
}

html {
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
html::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}



*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;}
a,button{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
body{
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--ff);
  overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
  transition:background .55s var(--ease-out),color .55s var(--ease-out);
  overscroll-behavior:none;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}
body:not(.touch-device){cursor:none}

/* FIX: Removed dotted radial-gradient background â€” was fragmenting every section visually */

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;}
  .t-track{animation:none!important}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
}

/* â”€â”€ CURSOR â”€â”€ */
#cur{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);will-change:transform;display:none;}
.cv,.ch{position:absolute;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);transition:width .22s var(--ease-out),height .22s var(--ease-out),opacity .18s;}
.cv{width:1px;height:20px;left:calc(50% - .5px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);}
.ch{height:1px;width:20px;top:calc(50% - .5px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);}
.cc{position:absolute;width:2.5px;height:2.5px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}

body.nav-hov .cv{height:48px;}
body.nav-hov .ch{width:48px;}
body.clicking .cv,body.clicking .ch,body.clicking .cc{opacity:.22;}

/* â”€â”€ MODE BAR â”€â”€ */
#mode-bar{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:var(--nav-w);right:0;height:28px;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.98);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  z-index:400;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--dim);gap:10px;pointer-events:none;transition:background .55s var(--ease-out),border-color .55s var(--ease-out);
}

#mode-bar kbd{
  font-family:var(--ff);font-size:8.5px;
  padding:1px 6px;border:1px solid var(--line-hi);
  border-radius:2px;color:var(--text);pointer-events:none;
}
#mode-bar .mobile-hint{display:none;}
@media(max-width:960px){
  #mode-bar .desktop-hint{display:none;}
  #mode-bar .mobile-hint{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
}




/* â”€â”€ ASCII RAIN â”€â”€ */
#rain{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;pointer-events:none;}

/* â”€â”€ NAV â”€â”€ */
#nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:var(--nav-w);height:100vh;
  border-right:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  padding:18px 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 18px);z-index:300;
  background:rgba(6,6,6,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  transition:background .55s var(--ease-out);
  will-change:transform;
}


.nav-logo{margin-bottom:22px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;border-radius:6px;position:relative;transition:background .16s;}
.nav-logo:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);}


.nav-logo svg{display:block;}
.nav-logo .nc{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}
.nav-logo .nz{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);}


.nav-links{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:4px 0;}
.nb{
  width:44px;height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-decoration:none;position:relative;border-radius:6px;
  transition:background var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out);cursor:none;
}
.nb:hover,.nb.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);}

.nb svg{
  width:16px;height:16px;stroke:var(--dim);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;
  stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;
  transition:stroke var(--t-mid) var(--ease-out);
}
.nb.on svg,.nb:hover svg{stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.8);}

.nb::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%) scaleY(0);
  width:2px;height:20px;background:var(--text);border-radius:0 1px 1px 0;
  transition:transform .42s var(--ease);will-change:transform;
}
.nb.on::before{transform:translateY(-50%) scaleY(1);}
.nb::after{
  content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;left:calc(100% + 10px);top:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%);background:rgba(16,16,16,.96);border:1px solid var(--line);
  font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text);
  padding:5px 10px;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:2px;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .14s;z-index:999;
}

.nb:hover::after{opacity:1;}
.nav-foot{padding:0 0 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.nav-blink{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:bwpulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;}

@keyframes bwpulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.18;transform:scale(.5)}}
#clk{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);letter-spacing:.06em;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);line-height:1;}

/* â”€â”€ MOBILE NAV â”€â”€ */
#m-toggle{
  display:none;
  position:fixed;top:6px;right:12px;z-index:2000;
  width:36px;height:36px;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.92);border:1px solid var(--line-hi);
  border-radius:4px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}

#m-toggle span{
  display:block;width:16px;height:1.5px;
  background:var(--text);border-radius:1px;
  transition:transform .3s var(--ease),opacity .2s;transform-origin:center;
}
body.m-open #m-toggle span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg);}
body.m-open #m-toggle span:nth-child(2){opacity:0;}
body.m-open #m-toggle span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg);}

#m-nav{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1500;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.98);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;visibility:hidden;
  transition:opacity .38s var(--ease-out),visibility .38s;
}

body.m-open #m-nav{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;visibility:visible;}
.m-nb{
  font-family:var(--fh);font-size:clamp(42px,9vw,64px);letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);text-decoration:none;
  transition:color .18s var(--ease),transform .2s var(--ease);
  padding:8px 0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.m-nb:hover,.m-nb.on{color:var(--text);transform:translateX(8px);}



/* â”€â”€ MAIN â”€â”€ */
#main{margin-left:var(--nav-w);padding-top:28px;position:relative;z-index:2;}

/* â”€â”€ HERO â”€â”€ */
#hero{
  height:calc(100vh - 28px);min-height:580px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
  padding:0 72px 56px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
#hc{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.6s var(--ease-out);}
#hc.visible{opacity:1;}
.h-grad{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:65%;
  background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(8,8,8,.94) 50%,transparent);
  pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
}

.h-tl{
  position:absolute;top:28px;left:72px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.22em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--hero-label);
  opacity:0;animation:fup .6s var(--ease) 1.5s forwards;z-index:2;
}
.h-tr{
  position:absolute;top:28px;right:72px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  color:var(--hero-label-dim);text-align:right;line-height:2;
  opacity:0;animation:fup .6s var(--ease) 1.7s forwards;z-index:2;
}
.h-eye{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--hero-accent);margin-bottom:18px;
  opacity:0;animation:fup .6s var(--ease) .4s forwards;position:relative;z-index:2;
}
.h-type-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-bottom:28px;}
#h-type{
  font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,38px);color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.3;min-height:1.4em;display:block;
}

#h-type .dc{opacity:.14;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}

#h-type .cur{
  display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.1em;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);vertical-align:middle;margin-left:2px;
  animation:curanm 1s step-end infinite;
}

@keyframes curanm{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}
.h-tags{
  display:flex;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;z-index:2;
  opacity:0;animation:fup .6s var(--ease) 1.05s forwards;
}
.htag{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--hero-tag);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.htag::before{content:"";width:12px;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.3;}
.h-scroll{
  position:absolute;bottom:50px;right:72px;writing-mode:vertical-rl;
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--hero-scroll);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  opacity:0;animation:fup .6s var(--ease) 2.2s forwards;z-index:2;
}
.h-scroll::after{
  content:"";width:1px;height:40px;background:var(--hero-scroll);
  transform-origin:top;animation:sv 2.8s 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes sv{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(0);opacity:0}35%,65%{transform:scaleY(1);opacity:1}}
@keyframes fup{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* â”€â”€ TICKER â”€â”€ */
.ticker{
  height:36px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.92);border-top:none;position:relative;z-index:3;
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0%,black 12%,black 88%,transparent 100%);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0%,black 12%,black 88%,transparent 100%);
}

.t-track{display:flex;white-space:nowrap;animation:tk 34s linear infinite;will-change:transform;}
.t-track span{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);padding:0 20px;text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.7),0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,.35);font-weight:600;}
.t-track .sep{color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding:0 2px;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.4);}

@keyframes tk{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* â”€â”€ SECTIONS â”€â”€ */
section{padding:96px 72px;position:relative;scroll-margin-top:28px;}
.s-lbl{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.32em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:64px;
}
.s-lbl::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line);}
section>*{position:relative;z-index:1;}
section a,section button{position:relative;z-index:10;pointer-events:auto;}

/* â”€â”€ ABOUT â”€â”€ */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:68px;align-items:start;}
.a-h{
  font-family:var(--fh);font-size:clamp(42px,5.8vw,82px);line-height:.93;
  letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:24px;
  text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,.1);
}
.a-h em{font-style:normal;color:var(--dim);}
.a-p{
  font-family:var(--fb);font-size:16px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--body);
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
}
.a-p+.a-p{margin-top:14px;}
.a-p strong{color:var(--text);}

/* â”€â”€ TERMINAL â”€â”€ */
.term-wrap{
  background:#0d0d0d;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-left:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;
}

.term-bar{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  padding:9px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1px;
  font-family:var(--ff);
}
.term-user{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
.term-sep{color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);font-size:10.5px;}
.term-path{color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
.term-cmd{color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-left:2px;}
.term-body{padding:22px 18px;font-size:13px;line-height:2.1;min-height:280px;overflow:hidden;}

/* prompt prefix â€” very dim */
.t-usr{color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);}
.t-at{color:rgba(255,255,255,.12);}
.t-host{color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);}
.t-sep{color:rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
.t-path{color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);}
.t-dol{color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);}

/* commands â€” slightly brighter */
.t-cmd{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-weight:600;}
.t-kw{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);font-weight:600;}
.t-var{color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);}
.t-str{color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);}
.t-num{color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);}
.t-pun{color:rgba(255,255,255,.15);}
.t-key{color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);}

/* comments â€” ghostly */
.t-cmt{color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);font-style:italic;}

/* output values â€” main readable content */
.tl-out{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);}
.t-out-val{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-weight:600;}

/* GLOW â€” the important stuff */
.t-hi2{
  color:#fff;font-weight:700;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.9),
    0 0 28px rgba(255,255,255,.55),
    0 0 55px rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}

/* contact terminal classes */
.ct-p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);font-style:italic;}
.ct-c{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);}
.ct-v{color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);}
.ct-h{
  color:#fff;font-weight:700;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.9),
    0 0 28px rgba(255,255,255,.55),
    0 0 55px rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}
.ct-blk{height:.6em;}
.term-cursor{
  display:inline-block;width:7px;height:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);vertical-align:middle;
  animation:blink 1.1s step-end infinite;
  box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}
.tl-blank{height:.7em;}


/* â”€â”€ EDUCATION â”€â”€ */
#education{overflow:hidden;}
.edu-wrap{position:relative;}

.edu-header{margin-bottom:48px;}
.edu-meta{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
.edu-meta::before{content:'';width:18px;height:1px;background:var(--dim);opacity:.5;}
.edu-degree{
  font-family:var(--fh);font-size:clamp(36px,5.5vw,78px);
  letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--text);line-height:.93;margin-bottom:10px;
}
.edu-uni{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:15px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:18px;}
.edu-tags-row{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.edu-badge-item{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--dim);border:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:5px 12px;border-radius:2px;
  transition:border-color .22s,color .22s;
}
.edu-badge-item.active{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}



/* â”€â”€ PIXEL PROGRESS BAR â”€â”€ */
.edu-progress-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-bottom:0;}
.edu-progress-label{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);
}
#pixel-decay-bar{
  width:100%;height:32px;display:block;
  image-rendering:pixelated;
}


/* â”€â”€ CERTIFICATIONS â”€â”€ */
#certifications{overflow:hidden;}

.cert-soon-box{
  width:100%;
  min-height:260px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:4px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  background:transparent;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  cursor:default;
  transition:border-color .35s var(--ease-out),background .35s var(--ease-out);
}
.cert-soon-box:hover{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}

/* animated corner brackets */
.cert-soon-box::before,.cert-soon-box::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  transition:all .45s var(--ease-out);
}
.cert-soon-box::before{
  top:0;left:0;
  width:16px;height:16px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.cert-soon-box::after{
  bottom:0;right:0;
  width:16px;height:16px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.cert-soon-box:hover::before{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
.cert-soon-box:hover::after{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}

/* scan line */
.cert-scan-line{
  position:absolute;
  top:-100%;left:0;right:0;
  height:100%;

.cert-soon-title{

.cert-soon-status::before{

.cert-tag{

/* â”€â”€ PROJECTS â”€â”€ */
#projects{overflow:visible;}
.pgrid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:14px;
  overflow:visible;
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
}
.pcard{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;
  padding:22px 20px;position:relative;
  background:var(--surface);
  transition:border-color .35s var(--ease-out),
             background .35s var(--ease-out);
  cursor:default;will-change:transform;
  z-index:1;
  overflow:visible;
}
.pcard::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:transparent;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 28px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .45s var(--ease-out);pointer-events:none;
  border-radius:4px;
}
.pcard::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:-1px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  border-radius:4px;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s var(--ease-out);pointer-events:none;
}
.pcard:hover{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  background:rgba(24,24,24,1);
  z-index:100;
}
.pcard:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.pcard:hover::after{opacity:1;}


.pc-icon{
  width:34px;height:34px;
  stroke:var(--dim);fill:none;
  stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;
  transition:stroke var(--t-mid) var(--ease-out);flex-shrink:0;
}
.pcard:hover .pc-icon{stroke:var(--text);}
.pc-ext{
  font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);text-decoration:none;
  transition:color var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out),transform .28s var(--ease-out);
  flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;padding:2px;
}
.pc-ext:hover,.pcard:hover .pc-ext{color:var(--text);transform:translate(2px,-2px);}
.pc-num{font-size:10px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:3px;}
.pc-name{
  font-family:var(--fh);font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--text);line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px;
  transition:text-shadow .22s var(--ease);
}
.pcard:hover .pc-name{text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,.25);}

.pc-meta{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:10px;
}
.pc-desc{
  font-family:var(--fb);font-size:14px;line-height:1.76;color:var(--body);
  margin-bottom:14px;
  display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;
}
.pc-tags{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.pc-tag{
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line-hi);
  background:transparent;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px;
  font-weight:600;opacity:.7;
}

.pc-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:14px;
  padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);
}
.pc-gh{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);text-decoration:none;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  padding:6px 12px;border-radius:2px;
  transition:color var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out),
             border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out),
             background var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pc-gh svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;}
.pc-gh:hover{
  color:#fff;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
.pc-live{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);text-decoration:none;margin-left:auto;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  padding:6px 12px;border-radius:2px;
  transition:color var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out),
             border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out),
             background var(--t-fast) var(--ease-out),
             transform .28s var(--ease-out);
}
.pc-live:hover{
  color:#fff;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  transform:translate(2px,-2px);
}

/* â”€â”€ CONTACT â”€â”€ */
.ct-prompt{
  font-family:var(--fh);font-size:clamp(52px,7vw,115px);line-height:.88;
  letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--text);padding-bottom:52px;cursor:none;
  opacity:.06;transition:opacity .8s var(--ease);
}
.ct-prompt.vis{opacity:1;}

.ct-prompt span{display:block;text-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(255,255,255,.15);}
.ct-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px;margin-bottom:52px;}
.ct-term{
  background:#0d0d0d;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-left:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;
}

.ct-bar{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  padding:9px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1px;
  font-family:var(--ff);
}
.ct-body{padding:20px 18px;font-size:13px;line-height:2.1;}
.ct-p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);font-style:italic;}
.ct-c{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
.ct-v{color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);}
.ct-h{color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.5),0 0 28px rgba(255,255,255,.18);}
.ct-blk{height:.6em;}
/* â”€â”€ CONTACT LINK CARDS (CV button style) â”€â”€ */
.social-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  position:relative;z-index:10;
  gap:8px; /* add gap to separate cards for bracket effect */
  border:none; /* remove unified border */
}

.s-link{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:22px 20px;
  text-decoration:none;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;z-index:10;
  border:none;
  background:transparent;
  color:var(--text); /* add this line */
  transition:color var(--t-mid) var(--ease-out);
  pointer-events:auto;
  font-family:var(--ff);
}
/* animated corner brackets â€” same as cv-btn */
.s-link::before,.s-link::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  transition:all .45s var(--ease-out);
}
.s-link::before{
  top:0;left:0;
  width:12px;height:12px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
}
.s-link::after{
  bottom:0;right:0;
  width:12px;height:12px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
}
.s-link:hover::before{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.s-link:hover::after{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.s-link:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}
/* scan line sweep â€” same as cv-btn */
.s-link .s-scan{
  position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;
}
.s-link .s-scan::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  top:-100%;left:0;right:0;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 50%,transparent 100%);
  transition:top .55s var(--ease-out);
}
.s-link:hover .s-scan::after{
  top:100%;
}
/* remove old pseudo effects */
.s-idx{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);transition:color var(--t-mid);}
.s-name{
  font-family:var(--fh);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.03em;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);transition:color var(--t-mid) var(--ease-out);
}
.s-link:hover .s-name{
  color:var(--text);
  text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.6);
}
.s-handle{
  font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);
  transition:color var(--t-mid) var(--ease-out);
}
.s-link:hover .s-handle{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}
.s-arr{
  position:absolute;top:20px;right:18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--faint);
  transition:color var(--t-mid),transform .32s var(--ease-out);
}
.s-link:hover .s-arr{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  transform:translate(3px,-3px);
}




/* responsive */
@media(max-width:960px){
  .social-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
}
@media(max-width:360px){
  .social-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}

/* â”€â”€ GO TO TOP â”€â”€ */
#go-top{
  position:fixed;bottom:32px;right:28px;z-index:800;
  width:42px;height:42px;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.95);border:1px solid var(--line-hi);
  border-radius:3px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  cursor:pointer;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity .45s var(--ease-out),transform .45s var(--ease-out),
             background var(--t-fast),border-color var(--t-fast);
  pointer-events:none;will-change:opacity,transform;
}
#go-top.vis{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);pointer-events:auto;}
#go-top:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
#go-top svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:var(--text);fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}

/* â”€â”€ MUSIC BUTTON â”€â”€ */
#music-btn{
  position:fixed;bottom:84px;right:28px;z-index:800;
  width:42px;height:42px;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.95);border:1px solid var(--line-hi);
  border-radius:3px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity .45s var(--ease-out),transform .45s var(--ease-out),
             background var(--t-fast),border-color var(--t-fast);
  pointer-events:none;will-change:opacity,transform;
}
#music-btn.vis{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);pointer-events:auto;}

#music-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
#music-btn svg{stroke:var(--text);}
#music-btn.muted svg{opacity:.35;}

#music-btn .wave-bars{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;
  position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
}
#music-btn .wave-bars span{
  display:block;width:2px;background:var(--text);border-radius:1px;
  opacity:.5;animation:wavebar 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
#music-btn .wave-bars span:nth-child(1){height:3px;animation-delay:0s;}
#music-btn .wave-bars span:nth-child(2){height:5px;animation-delay:.15s;}
#music-btn .wave-bars span:nth-child(3){height:4px;animation-delay:.3s;}
#music-btn.muted .wave-bars span{animation-play-state:paused;opacity:.15;}
@keyframes wavebar{
  0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1);opacity:.5;}
  50%{transform:scaleY(1.8);opacity:.9;}
}

/* â”€â”€ REVEAL â”€â”€ */
.rv{
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);
  transition:opacity .8s var(--ease-out),transform .8s var(--ease-out);
  will-change:opacity,transform;
}
.rv.vis{opacity:1;transform:none;}
.rvs>*{
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);
  transition:opacity .55s var(--ease-out);
  will-change:transform;
}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(1){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:0s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(2){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.05s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(3){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.1s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(4){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.15s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(5){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.2s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(6){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.25s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(7){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.3s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(8){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.35s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(9){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.4s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(10){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.45s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(11){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.5s}
.rvs.vis>*:nth-child(12){opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.55s}

/* â”€â”€ CV + EMAIL BUTTONS â”€â”€ */
.cv-btn, .email-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;
  font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;padding:17px 30px;
  font-family:var(--ff);position:relative;z-index:10;
  border:none;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;
  transition:color .22s var(--ease-out);
}
.cv-btn::before,.email-btn::before,
.cv-btn::after,.email-btn::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;transition:all .45s var(--ease-out);
}
/* animated corner brackets */
.cv-btn::before,.email-btn::before{
  top:0;left:0;
  width:12px;height:12px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
}
.cv-btn::after,.email-btn::after{
  bottom:0;right:0;
  width:12px;height:12px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
}
.cv-btn:hover::before,.email-btn:hover::before{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.cv-btn:hover::after,.email-btn:hover::after{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.cv-btn:hover,.email-btn:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.6);
}
.cv-btn .btn-icon,.email-btn .btn-icon{
  font-size:15px;
  transition:transform .32s var(--ease-out);
}
.cv-btn:hover .btn-icon{ transform:translateY(3px); }
.email-btn:hover .btn-icon{ transform:translate(3px,-3px); }

/* scan line sweep on hover */
.cv-btn .btn-scan,.email-btn .btn-scan{
  position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;
}
.cv-btn .btn-scan::after,.email-btn .btn-scan::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  top:-100%;left:0;right:0;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 50%,transparent 100%);
  transition:top .55s var(--ease-out);
}
.cv-btn:hover .btn-scan::after,.email-btn:hover .btn-scan::after{
  top:100%;
}

/* counter label */

<script>
    'use strict';
history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
window.scrollTo(0, 0);

let pageVisible = true;
let globeVisible = true;
let starLastFrame = 0;
const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  pageVisible = !document.hidden;
});
const heroObs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  globeVisible = entries[0].isIntersecting;
}, { threshold: 0 });
heroObs.observe(document.getElementById('hero'));




/* â•â• TOUCH DETECTION â•â• */
const isTouch = ('ontouchstart' in window) || (navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0);
if (isTouch) {
  document.body.classList.add('touch-device');
} else {
  document.getElementById('cur').style.display = 'block';
}


/* â•â• ASCII RAIN + SPLASH â•â• */
(function(){
  const c = document.getElementById('rain');
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';

  let W, H;
  function resize(){
    W = c.width  = window.innerWidth;
    H = c.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resize();

  const RAIN_CHARS = '01ã‚¢ã‚¤ã‚¦ã‚¨ã‚ªã‚«ã‚­ã‚¯ã‚±ã‚³EFGH{}[]<>/\\|#@$%^&*()_+=-ABCDfunc(){return}importconst';
  const FS = 13;
  let cols, drops, speeds, brightnesses;

  function initDrops(){
    cols        = Math.floor(W / FS);
    drops       = new Array(cols).fill(0).map(() => Math.random() * -60);
    speeds      = new Array(cols).fill(0).map(() => 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7);
    brightnesses= new Array(cols).fill(0).map(() => Math.random());
  }
  initDrops();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { resize(); initDrops(); recompute(); }, {passive:true});

  const TITLE = 'ZAHID';
  const TITLE_FONT = '700 ';
  const TITLE_FF   = '"JetBrains Mono", monospace';
  let titleFS, titleY, letterRects;
  let layoutReady = false;

  function recompute(){
    titleFS = Math.max(64, Math.min(Math.floor(W * 0.11), 112));
    titleY  = Math.floor(H * 0.47);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = `${TITLE_FONT}${titleFS}px ${TITLE_FF}`;
    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
    const spacing = titleFS * 0.06;
    let totalW = 0;
    const widths = [];
    for (const ch of TITLE){
      const w = ctx.measureText(ch).width;
      widths.push(w);
      totalW += w + spacing;
    }
    totalW -= spacing;
    let x = W / 2 - totalW / 2;
    letterRects = TITLE.split('').map((ch, i) => {
      const rect = { x, w: widths[i], ch };
      x += widths[i] + spacing;
      return rect;
    });
    ctx.restore();
    layoutReady = true;
  }

  const revealState    = new Float32Array(TITLE.length);
  const letterFlash    = new Float32Array(TITLE.length);
  let startTS = null, allRevealedAt = null, exiting = false;
  const MIN_TOTAL_MS = 2000, MIN_RAIN_MS = 800, POST_REVEAL_MS = 550;

  /* fake loading messages */
  const loadMsgs = [
    'initializing systems...',
    'loading assets...',
    'compiling portfolio...',
    'almost ready...',
    'ready.'
  ];
  let loadMsgIdx = 0;
  let loadMsgTimer = 0;

  /* exit speed multiplier */
  let exitSpeedMul = 1;

  function doExit(){
    if (exiting) return;
    exiting = true;
    /* speed up rain then collapse */
    exitSpeedMul = 1;
    let speedFrame = 0;
    function speedUp(){
      speedFrame++;
      exitSpeedMul = 1 + speedFrame * 0.18;
      if(exitSpeedMul < 12) requestAnimationFrame(speedUp);
      else {
        c.style.transition = 'opacity 0.65s ease';
        c.style.opacity = '0';
        c.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        document.getElementById('hc').classList.add('visible');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('splashDone'));
        setTimeout(() => { c.style.display = 'none'; }, 800);
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(speedUp);
  }

  function draw(ts){
    if (exiting && exitSpeedMul >= 12) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    if (!startTS) startTS = ts;
    const elapsed = ts - startTS;

    /* update loading message */
    loadMsgTimer += 16;
    if(loadMsgTimer > 900 && loadMsgIdx < loadMsgs.length - 1){
      loadMsgIdx++;
      loadMsgTimer = 0;
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,8,8,0.055)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
    for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++){
      const speed  = speeds[i] * exitSpeedMul;
      const bright = brightnesses[i];
      const cy = drops[i] * FS;
      const ch = RAIN_CHARS[Math.floor(Math.random() * RAIN_CHARS.length)];
      const cx = i * FS;

      /* trail â€” dim character behind */
      if(drops[i] > 1){
        ctx.font = `${FS}px "JetBrains Mono", monospace`;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.04 + bright * 0.08})`;
        ctx.fillText(ch, cx, cy - FS * 2);
      }

      /* main character */
      const alpha = 0.08 + Math.random() * (0.4 + bright * 0.3);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
      ctx.font = `${FS}px "JetBrains Mono", monospace`;
      ctx.fillText(ch, cx, cy);

      /* bright head character */
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.6 + bright * 0.4})`;
      ctx.fillText(RAIN_CHARS[Math.floor(Math.random() * RAIN_CHARS.length)], cx, cy + FS);


      if (layoutReady && elapsed > MIN_RAIN_MS){
  if (cy >= titleY - titleFS * 0.85 && cy <= titleY + titleFS * 0.18){
    for (let j = 0; j < TITLE.length; j++){
      if (revealState[j] < 1){
        // only reveal if previous letter is already done
        const prevDone = j === 0 || revealState[j-1] >= 1;
        if(!prevDone) continue;
        const lr = letterRects[j];
        if (cx >= lr.x - FS * 0.5 && cx <= lr.x + lr.w + FS * 0.5){
          revealState[j] = Math.min(1, revealState[j] + 0.09);
          if(revealState[j] >= 1) letterFlash[j] = 1.0;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

      if (elapsed > 2600 && revealState[i % TITLE.length] < 1){
        revealState[i % TITLE.length] = Math.min(1, revealState[i % TITLE.length] + 0.006);
      }
      if (drops[i] * FS > H && Math.random() > 0.975) drops[i] = 0;
      drops[i] += speed;
    }

    if (layoutReady){
      ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
      for (let j = 0; j < TITLE.length; j++){
        const a = revealState[j];
        if (a > 0){
          ctx.font = `${TITLE_FONT}${titleFS}px ${TITLE_FF}`;

          /* flash pulse when letter first resolves */
          if(letterFlash[j] > 0){
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${Math.min(1, a * 0.92 + letterFlash[j] * 0.5)})`;
            letterFlash[j] = Math.max(0, letterFlash[j] - 0.045);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${a * 0.92})`;
          }
          ctx.fillText(letterRects[j].ch, letterRects[j].x, titleY);
        }
      }

      /* segmented progress bar */
      const prog = Array.from(revealState).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / TITLE.length;
      const barW = 180, barX = W / 2 - barW / 2;
      const barY = titleY + Math.round(titleFS * 0.52);
      const SEGS = 20;
      const segW = Math.floor(barW / SEGS);
      const filledSegs = Math.floor(prog * SEGS);

      ctx.font = `10px "JetBrains Mono", monospace`;
      for(let s=0;s<SEGS;s++){
        const sx = barX + s * segW;
        if(s < filledSegs){
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
          ctx.fillText('â–ˆ', sx, barY + 2);
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
          ctx.fillText('â–‘', sx, barY + 2);
        }
      }

      /* percentage */
      const pct = Math.round(prog * 100);
      ctx.font = `9px "JetBrains Mono", monospace`;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(`${pct}%`, W / 2, barY + 18);

      /* cycling loading message */
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
      ctx.fillText(loadMsgs[loadMsgIdx], W / 2, barY + 32);

      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    }

    const allDone = Array.from(revealState).every(v => v >= 1);
    if (allDone && !allRevealedAt) allRevealedAt = ts;
    if (allRevealedAt && elapsed >= MIN_TOTAL_MS && ts - allRevealedAt >= POST_REVEAL_MS && !exiting) doExit();
    if (elapsed > 9000 && !exiting) doExit();
  }

  Promise.all([
    document.fonts.load(`700 100px "JetBrains Mono"`),
    document.fonts.load('400 13px "JetBrains Mono"')
  ]).then(() => {
    recompute();
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }).catch(() => {
    setTimeout(() => { recompute(); requestAnimationFrame(draw); }, 800);
  });

  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!layoutReady){ recompute(); if (!exiting) requestAnimationFrame(draw); }
  }, 1500);
})();

/* â•â• CURSOR â•â• */
if (!isTouch) {
  const cur = document.getElementById('cur');
  let mx = window.innerWidth / 2, my = window.innerHeight / 2;
  let rx = mx, ry = my;
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { mx = e.clientX; my = e.clientY; }, {passive:true});
  (function loop(){
    if (!pageVisible) return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    rx += (mx - rx) * 1; ry += (my - ry) * 1;
    cur.style.transform = `translate(calc(${rx}px - 50%), calc(${ry}px - 50%))`;
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  })();
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
    document.body.classList.add('clicking');
    setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove('clicking'), 180);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nb').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => document.body.classList.add('nav-hov'));
    b.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => document.body.classList.remove('nav-hov'));
  });

  const hoverEls = 'a, button, .pcard, .s-link, .nav-logo, [role="button"]';
  document.querySelectorAll(hoverEls).forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => document.body.classList.add('nav-hov'));
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => document.body.classList.remove('nav-hov'));
  });
}

/* â•â• CLOCK â•â• */
const clk = document.getElementById('clk');
function tick(){
  const d = new Date(), z = n => String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  clk.textContent = z(d.getHours()) + ':' + z(d.getMinutes());
}
setInterval(tick, 1000); tick();

/* â•â• SCROLL PROGRESS + GO TOP â•â• */
const goTop = document.getElementById('go-top');
let scrollRAF = false;
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  if (scrollRAF) return;
  scrollRAF = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const scrollable = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight;
    const p = scrollable > 0 ? (scrollY / scrollable * 100) : 0;
    document.getElementById('spb-side').style.height = p + '%';
    goTop.classList.toggle('vis', scrollY > 400);
    scrollRAF = false;
  });
}, {passive:true});

/* â•â• DESKTOP NAV â•â• */
const secs = [...document.querySelectorAll('section[id]')];
const nbs  = [...document.querySelectorAll('.nb')];
const modeBarH = () => {
  const el = document.getElementById('mode-bar');
  return el ? parseInt(getComputedStyle(el).height) || 28 : 28;
};
nbs.forEach(b => {
  b.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const target = document.getElementById(b.dataset.s);
    if (target) {
      const top = target.offsetTop - modeBarH();
      window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  });
});
const ioNav = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting){
      nbs.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.s === e.target.id));
      document.querySelectorAll('.m-nb').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.s === e.target.id));
    }
  });
}, {rootMargin:'-42% 0px -42% 0px'});

/* â•â• PIXEL PROGRESS BAR â•â• */
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('pixel-decay-bar');
  if(!canvas) return;
  const TOTAL = 12, DONE = 5;
  const PX = 6, GAP = 2;
  let drawn = false;

  function draw(){
    const W = canvas.parentElement.clientWidth;
    const H = 32;
    canvas.width = W;
    canvas.height = H;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    const cols = Math.floor(W / (PX + GAP));
    const filledCols = Math.round((DONE / TOTAL) * cols);

    for(let col = 0; col < cols; col++){
      const x = col * (PX + GAP);
      const rows = Math.floor(H / (PX + GAP));
      for(let row = 0; row < rows; row++){
        const y = row * (PX + GAP);
        if(col < filledCols){
          const op = 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${op})`;
          ctx.fillRect(x, y, PX, PX);
        } else if(col === filledCols){
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,0.9)`;
          ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,1)';
          ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          ctx.fillRect(x, y, PX, PX);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`;
          ctx.fillRect(x, y, PX, PX);
        }
      }
    }

    
  }

  function flicker(){
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    const cols = Math.floor(W / (PX + GAP));
    const filledCols = Math.round((DONE / TOTAL) * cols);
    const rows = Math.floor(H / (PX + GAP));
    for(let col = 0; col < filledCols; col++){
      const x = col * (PX + GAP);
      for(let row = 0; row < rows; row++){
        const y = row * (PX + GAP);
        if(Math.random() < 0.28){
          const on = Math.random() > 0.15;
          if(on){
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.45 + Math.random()*0.5})`;
            ctx.fillRect(x, y, PX, PX);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(8,8,8,1)`;
            ctx.fillRect(x, y, PX, PX);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if(e.isIntersecting && !drawn){
        drawn = true; obs.disconnect();
        draw();
        setInterval(flicker, 90);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold: 0.3});
  obs.observe(canvas);

  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { if(drawn) draw(); }, {passive:true});
})();

/* â•â• HERO DECODE TYPING â•â• */
(function(){
  const target  = document.getElementById('h-type');
  const text    = 'yo, have a look around the portfolio.';
  const glyphs  = '!@#$%^&*_+=-[]{}|;:<>?/~`ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
  let resolved  = 0, started = false;

  function step(){
    let html = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++){
      if (i < resolved)        html += `<span>${text[i]}</span>`;
      else if (i === resolved) html += `<span class="cur"></span>`;
      else                     html += `<span class="dc">${glyphs[Math.floor(Math.random()*glyphs.length)]}</span>`;
    }
    target.innerHTML = html;
    if (resolved < text.length){
      resolved++;
      setTimeout(() => requestAnimationFrame(step), 38);
    } else {
      target.textContent = text;
    }
  }

  function startType(){ if (!started){ started = true; requestAnimationFrame(step); } }
  window.addEventListener('splashDone', () => setTimeout(startType, 300), {once:true});
  setTimeout(startType, 5000);
})();

/* â•â• SCRAMBLE ON HOVER â•â• */
(function(){
  const CHARS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!@#$%&*?/|\\';
  function scramble(el){
    const original = el.dataset.orig || el.textContent.trim();
    el.dataset.orig = original;
    let resolved = 0;
    const total = original.length;
    const RESOLVE_EVERY = 3;
    let f = 0;
    function tick(){
      let out = '';
      for(let i = 0; i < total; i++){
        if(i < resolved) out += original[i];
        else if(original[i] === ' ') out += ' ';
        else out += CHARS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CHARS.length)];
      }
      el.textContent = out;
      f++;
      if(f % RESOLVE_EVERY === 0) resolved++;
      if(resolved <= total) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else el.textContent = original;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  // Scramble on social links â€” targets the .s-name element
  document.querySelectorAll('.s-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      const name = link.querySelector('.s-name');
      if(name) scramble(name);
    });
  });
})();

/* â•â• CONTACT PROMPT CYCLE â•â• */
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('ct-prompt');
  if (!el) return;
  const phrases = [
    ["LET'S","BUILD","SOMETHING."],
    ["GOT AN","IDEA?","TALK TO ME."],
    ["LET'S","SHIP","TOGETHER."],
    ["REACH","OUT.","I RESPOND."],
  ];
  const GLYPHS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ!@#$%?&*-+';
  let idx = 0, loopStarted = false;

  function renderSpans(lines){ el.innerHTML = lines.map(l=>`<span>${l}</span>`).join(''); }

  function scrambleIn(lines, done){
    renderSpans(lines);
    const spanEls = [...el.querySelectorAll('span')];
    const positions = [];
    lines.forEach((line, si) => { for(let ci=0;ci<line.length;ci++) positions.push([si,ci]); });
    for(let i=positions.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[positions[i],positions[j]]=[positions[j],positions[i]]; }
    const resolved = lines.map(l => new Array(l.length).fill(false));
    let ptr = 0;
    const BATCH = 3;
    function tick(){
      for(let b=0;b<BATCH&&ptr<positions.length;b++,ptr++){
        const [si,ci] = positions[ptr];
        resolved[si][ci] = true;
      }
      spanEls.forEach((span, si) => {
        let s='';
        for(let ci=0;ci<lines[si].length;ci++){
          if(resolved[si][ci]) s += lines[si][ci];
          else if(lines[si][ci]===' ') s+=' ';
          else s += GLYPHS[Math.floor(Math.random()*GLYPHS.length)];
        }
        span.textContent = s;
      });
      if(ptr < positions.length) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else { renderSpans(lines); if(done) done(); }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function cycle(){
    idx = (idx+1) % phrases.length;
    scrambleIn(phrases[idx], () => { setTimeout(cycle, 3500); });
  }

  const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if(e.isIntersecting && !loopStarted){
        loopStarted = true;
        obs.disconnect();
        renderSpans(phrases[0]);
        setTimeout(cycle, 3500);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold:0.1});
  obs.observe(el);
})();


/* â•â• BACKGROUND MUSIC â•â• */
(function(){
  const audio   = document.getElementById('bg-music');
  const btn     = document.getElementById('music-btn');
  const iconOn  = document.getElementById('music-icon-on');
  const iconOff = document.getElementById('music-icon-off');
  let   playing = false;

  audio.volume = 0.25;

  function setPlaying(val){
    playing = val;
    if(playing){
      audio.play().catch(()=>{});
      iconOn.style.display  = '';
      iconOff.style.display = 'none';
      btn.classList.remove('muted');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label','Pause music');
    } else {
      audio.pause();
      iconOn.style.display  = 'none';
      iconOff.style.display = '';
      btn.classList.add('muted');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label','Play music');
    }
  }

  btn.addEventListener('click', () => setPlaying(!playing));

  window.addEventListener('splashDone', () => {
    setTimeout(() => btn.classList.add('vis'), 600);
  }, {once:true});
  setTimeout(() => btn.classList.add('vis'), 6000);

  function tryAutoplay(){
    if(!playing) setPlaying(true);
    document.removeEventListener('click',      tryAutoplay);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown',    tryAutoplay);
    document.removeEventListener('touchstart', tryAutoplay);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',      tryAutoplay, {once:true});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',    tryAutoplay, {once:true});
  document.addEventListener('touchstart', tryAutoplay, {once:true, passive:true});
})();

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
   GLOBE v3 â€” Lat/lon grid + orbital rings + atmosphere
   glow + floating data particles + arc connections
   + scanning sweep + HUD readout sprites
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('hc');
  const hero   = document.getElementById('hero');
  const W = () => hero.clientWidth;
  const H = () => hero.clientHeight;

  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias: !isTouch, alpha: true});
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 1.5));
  renderer.setClearColor(0, 0);
  renderer.setSize(W(), H());

  function onHeroResize(){
    renderer.setSize(W(), H());
    cam.aspect = W() / H();
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', onHeroResize, {passive:true});

  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  const cam   = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(34, W()/H(), .1, 100);
  cam.position.set(0, 0.2, 6.8);
  cam.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

  /* â”€â”€ Root groups â”€â”€ */
  const globe    = new THREE.Group(); // rotates with globe
  const staticGp = new THREE.Group(); // stays fixed in world space
  scene.add(globe);
  scene.add(staticGp);

  const R = 1.7;

  /* â”€â”€ Color helpers â”€â”€ */
  function isDark(){ return !document.body.classList.contains('light'); }

  let _currentGridColor    = new THREE.Color();
  let _currentEquatorColor = new THREE.Color();
  function getGridColor(){
    return isDark() ? new THREE.Color(0.92,0.92,0.92) : new THREE.Color(0.15,0.15,0.15);
  }
  function getEquatorColor(){
    return isDark() ? new THREE.Color(1,1,1) : new THREE.Color(0.10,0.10,0.10);
  }

  /* â”€â”€ All theme-aware materials collected here â”€â”€ */
  const themeMats = []; // {mat, type:'grid'|'equator'|'ring'|'particle'|'arc'|'sweep'}

  function mkLineMat(type, opacity){
    const col = type === 'equator' ? getEquatorColor() : getGridColor();
    const m = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:col.clone(), transparent:true, opacity});
    themeMats.push({mat:m, type});
    return m;
  }

  /* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
     1. LAT / LON GRID
  â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
  const gridLines = [];

  const latitudes = [-75,-60,-45,-30,-15,0,15,30,45,60,75];
  latitudes.forEach(latDeg => {
    const lat = latDeg * Math.PI/180;
    const r   = R * Math.cos(lat);
    const y   = R * Math.sin(lat);
    const segs = 96;
    const pts = [];
    for(let i=0;i<=segs;i++){
      const a=(i/segs)*Math.PI*2;
      pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a)*r, y, Math.sin(a)*r));
    }
    const isEquator = latDeg===0;
    const op = isEquator ? 0.5 : Math.abs(latDeg)===15||Math.abs(latDeg)===30 ? 0.22 : 0.11;
    const mat = mkLineMat(isEquator?'equator':'grid', op);
    const line = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), mat);
    globe.add(line);
    gridLines.push({mat, isEquator});
  });

  const longitudes = [0,15,30,45,60,75,90,105,120,135,150,165,180,195,210,225,240,255,270,285,300,315,330,345];
  longitudes.forEach((lonDeg,idx) => {
    const lon = lonDeg * Math.PI/180;
    const segs = 72;
    const pts = [];
    for(let i=0;i<=segs;i++){
      const a=(i/segs)*Math.PI - Math.PI/2;
      pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.cos(a)*Math.cos(lon)*R,
        Math.sin(a)*R,
        Math.cos(a)*Math.sin(lon)*R
      ));
    }
    const isPrime = lonDeg%30===0;
    const op = isPrime ? 0.18 : 0.07;
    const mat = mkLineMat('grid', op);
    const line = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), mat);
    globe.add(line);
    gridLines.push({mat, isEquator:false});
  });

  /* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
     2. ATMOSPHERE GLOW (billboard sprite)
  â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
  function makeAtmoTex(){
    const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=cv.height=512;
    const x=cv.getContext('2d');
    const g=x.createRadialGradient(256,256,160,256,256,256);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    g.addColorStop(0.72,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    g.addColorStop(0.84,isDark()?'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)':'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)');
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    x.fillStyle=g; x.fillRect(0,0,512,512);
    return new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
  }
  let atmoTex = makeAtmoTex();
  const atmoMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:atmoTex, transparent:true, depthWrite:false, opacity:1});
  const atmoSprite = new THREE.Sprite(atmoMat);
  atmoSprite.scale.set(4.1,4.1,1);
  scene.add(atmoSprite); // world-space so it doesn't rotate

  /* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
     3. ORBITAL RINGS (world-space, independent rotation)
  â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
  function makeRing(radius, tiltX, tiltZ, op, dashed){
    const segs = dashed ? 120 : 180;
    const pts = [];
    for(let i=0;i<=segs;i++){
      const skip = dashed && (i%8 < 3);
      if(!skip){
        const a=(i/segs)*Math.PI*2;
        pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a)*radius, 0, Math.sin(a)*radius));
      } else {
        if(pts.length){ /* gap â€” push degenerate */ }
      }
    }
    // build as continuous line with gaps via separate segments
    const allPts = [];
    for(let i=0;i<=segs;i++){
      const a=(i/segs)*Math.PI*2;
      allPts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a)*radius, 0, Math.sin(a)*radius));
    }
    const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: getGridColor().clone(), transparent:true, opacity:op
    });
    themeMats.push({mat, type:'ring'});
    const grp = new THREE.Group();
    grp.rotation.x = tiltX;
    grp.rotation.z = tiltZ;
    const line = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(allPts), mat);
    grp.add(line);
    scene.add(grp);
    return grp;
  }

  const ring1 = makeRing(2.55, Math.PI/2.2,  Math.PI/7,  0.28, false); // equatorial-ish
  const ring2 = makeRing(2.85, Math.PI/3.5, -Math.PI/5,  0.16, true);  // tilted dashed

/* â•â• MAGNETIC CARD HOVER â•â• */
(function(){
  function lerp(a,b,t){return a+(b-a)*t;}

  function attachCard(card){
    let raf=null;
    let rotX=0,rotY=0,scale=1,lift=0;
    let tRotX=0,tRotY=0,tScale=1,tLift=0;
    let inside=false;

    function animate(){
      rotX  = lerp(rotX,  tRotX,  0.18);
      rotY  = lerp(rotY,  tRotY,  0.18);
      scale = lerp(scale, tScale, 0.18);
      lift  = lerp(lift,  tLift,  0.18);

      card.style.transform = `perspective(900px) rotateX(${rotX}deg) rotateY(${rotY}deg) translateY(${-lift}px) scale(${scale})`;
      card.style.boxShadow = inside
        ? `${-rotY*1.5}px ${rotX*1.5}px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 28px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.65),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 0 70px rgba(255,255,255,.04)`
        : '';

      const done =
        Math.abs(rotX-tRotX)<0.05 &&
        Math.abs(rotY-tRotY)<0.05 &&
        Math.abs(scale-tScale)<0.001 &&
        Math.abs(lift-tLift)<0.05;

      raf = done ? null : requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    function go(){ if(!raf) raf=requestAnimationFrame(animate); }

    card.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{
      inside=true; tScale=1.06; tLift=22;
      card.style.borderColor='rgba(255,255,255,.4)';
      card.style.background='rgba(24,24,24,1)';
      card.style.zIndex='100';
      go();
    });
    card.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
      const r=card.getBoundingClientRect();
      tRotX=((e.clientY-r.top -r.height/2)/(r.height/2))*-10;
      tRotY=((e.clientX-r.left-r.width /2)/(r.width /2))* 10;
      go();
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{
      inside=false; tRotX=0; tRotY=0; tScale=1; tLift=0;
      card.style.borderColor='';
      card.style.background='';
      card.style.zIndex='';
      go();
    });
  }

// Attach to all cards immediately â€” desktop only
if(!isTouch){
  document.querySelectorAll('.pcard').forEach(attachCard);
}

  // Re-attach when scroll reveal adds .vis class
if(!isTouch){
  new MutationObserver(()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.pcard:not([data-mag])').forEach(card=>{
      card.setAttribute('data-mag','1');
      attachCard(card);
    });
  }).observe(document.querySelector('.pgrid')||document.body,
    {attributes:true,subtree:true,childList:true,attributeFilter:['class','style']}
  );
  document.querySelectorAll('.pcard').forEach(c=>c.setAttribute('data-mag','1'));
}
})();

    lines.forEach((line,si)=>{ for(let ci=0;ci<line.length;ci++) positions.push([si,ci]); });
    for(let i=positions.length-1;i>0;i--){
      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      [positions[i],positions[j]]=[positions[j],positions[i]];
    }
    const resolved = lines.map(l=>new Array(l.length).fill(false));
    let ptr=0;
    const BATCH=3;
    function tick(){
      for(let b=0;b<BATCH&&ptr<positions.length;b++,ptr++){
        const [si,ci]=positions[ptr];
        resolved[si][ci]=true;
      }
      spanEls.forEach((span,si)=>{
        let s='';
        for(let ci=0;ci<lines[si].length;ci++){
          if(resolved[si][ci]) s+=lines[si][ci];
          else if(lines[si][ci]===' ') s+=' ';
          else s+=GLYPHS[Math.floor(Math.random()*GLYPHS.length)];
        }
        span.textContent=s;
      });
      if(ptr<positions.length) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else{ renderSpans(lines); if(done) done(); }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function cycle(){
    idx=(idx+1)%phrases.length;
    scrambleIn(phrases[idx], ()=>{ setTimeout(cycle, 3500); });
  }

  const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting && !loopStarted){
        loopStarted=true;
        obs.disconnect();
        renderSpans(phrases[0]);
        setTimeout(cycle, 3500);
      }
    });
  },{threshold:0.2});
  obs.observe(el);
})();

(function(){

  const DEFAULT = () => window.innerWidth <= 960 ? 3 : 6;

    if(!expanded){
      extra.forEach(c => { c.style.display = 'none'; c.classList.remove('pc-reveal'); });
      btn.innerHTML = 'Load More â†“';

          c.classList.add('pc-reveal');
        }));
      });
      btn.innerHTML = 'Show Less â†‘';
    }
  }

  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    expanded = !expanded;
    apply(true);
    if(!expanded) document.getElementById('projects')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
  });
  apply(false);

  let rt;

    clearTimeout(rt);

  }, {passive:true});
})();

    document.body.appendChild(d);
    trail.push(d);
    pos.push({x:-200, y:-200});
  }
  (function trailLoop(){
    if (!pageVisible) return requestAnimationFrame(trailLoop);
    pos[0].x += (mx2 - pos[0].x) * 0.35;
    pos[0].y += (my2 - pos[0].y) * 0.35;
    for(let i = 1; i < N; i++){
      pos[i].x += (pos[i-1].x - pos[i].x) * 0.50;
      pos[i].y += (pos[i-1].y - pos[i].y) * 0.50;
    }
    trail.forEach((d,i) => d.style.transform = `translate(calc(${pos[i].x}px - 50%),calc(${pos[i].y}px - 50%))`);
    requestAnimationFrame(trailLoop);
  })();
}

(function(){
  const c = document.getElementById('star-bg');
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  let W, H;

  function resize(){
    W = c.width  = window.innerWidth;
    H = c.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize, {passive:true});

  const STAR_COUNT = 320;
  const stars = [];

  for(let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++){
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random(),
      y: Math.random(),
      r: Math.random() * 1.1 + 0.2,
      op: Math.random() * 0.55 + 0.12,
      twinkleSpeed: 0.004 + Math.random() * 0.008,
      twinkleOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.00004,
    });
  }

  /* Sparse large "deep field" stars */
  const deepStars = [];
  for(let i = 0; i < 35; i++){
    deepStars.push({
      x: Math.random(),
      y: Math.random(),
      r: 1.4 + Math.random() * 1.1,
      op: 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.18,
      twinkleSpeed: 0.002 + Math.random() * 0.004,
      twinkleOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }

  /* Sparse nebula wisps â€” subtle radial patches */
  

  let t = 0;

  function draw(ts){
    if (!pageVisible) return requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    if (ts - starLastFrame < 33) return;
    starLastFrame = ts;
    t += 0.016;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);


    /* Deep field stars */
    deepStars.forEach(s => {
      const twinkle = Math.sin(t * s.twinkleSpeed * 60 + s.twinkleOffset) * 0.5 + 0.5;
      const op = s.op * (0.6 + twinkle * 0.4);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x * W, s.y * H, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220,228,255,${op})`;
      ctx.fill();
    });

    /* Main stars */
    stars.forEach(s => {
      s.x += s.drift;
      if(s.x > 1) s.x = 0;
      if(s.x < 0) s.x = 1;

      const twinkle = Math.sin(t * s.twinkleSpeed * 60 + s.twinkleOffset) * 0.5 + 0.5;
      const op = s.op * (0.55 + twinkle * 0.45);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x * W, s.y * H, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);

      /* Slight blue-white tint on bigger stars, pure white on small ones */
      const tint = s.r > 0.9 ? `rgba(210,222,255,${op})` : `rgba(255,255,255,${op})`;
      ctx.fillStyle = tint;
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  draw();





})();

<script>
  function selectPlan(plan, price, students) {
    // Scroll to contact
    document.getElementById('contact').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })

    // Pre-fill students dropdown
    const sel = document.getElementById('f-students')
    for (let i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
      if (sel.options[i].value === students || sel.options[i].text === students) {
        sel.selectedIndex = i
        break
      }
    }

    // Pre-fill message
    const msg = document.getElementById('f-msg')
    msg.value = `Interested in the ${plan} Plan (${price}).`

    // Show plan banner
    const banner = document.getElementById('plan-banner')
    banner.style.display = 'block'
    banner.innerHTML = `âœ“  <strong style="color:#fff">${plan} Plan</strong>  Â·  ${price}`

    // Focus name field
    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('f-name').focus(), 600)
  }

  async function submitForm() {
    const name     = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim()
    const platform = document.getElementById('f-platform').value.trim()
    const email    = document.getElementById('f-email').value.trim()
    const students = document.getElementById('f-students').value
    const msg      = document.getElementById('f-msg').value.trim()

    if (!name || !platform || !email) {
      alert('Please fill in your name, platform name, and email.')
      return
    }

    const btn = document.getElementById('submit-btn')
    btn.disabled = true
    btn.textContent = 'Sending...'

    try {
      // Formspree â€” replace YOUR_FORM_ID with your actual ID from formspree.io
      const res = await fetch('https://formspree.io/f/mjgawdwb', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, platform, email, students, message: msg })
      })

      if (res.ok) {
        document.getElementById('contact-form').style.display = 'none'
        document.getElementById('form-success').style.display = 'block'
      } else {
        btn.disabled = false
        btn.textContent = 'Send Request â†’'
        alert('Something went wrong. Please email us directly.')
      }
    } catch(e) {
      btn.disabled = false
      btn.textContent = 'Send Request â†’'
      alert('Network error. Please try again.')
    }
  }

  function switchTab(index) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.code-tab').forEach((t, i) => {
      t.classList.toggle('active', i === index)
    })
    document.getElementById('code-block-cdn').style.display = index === 0 ? 'block' : 'none'
    document.getElementById('code-block-npm').style.display = index === 1 ? 'block' : 'none'
  }
  window.switchTab = switchTab
</script>
